dataset_metadata.name: Voyage AI Local Travel Knowledge Base
dataset_metadata.description: Curated local destination knowledge base for rule-based travel planning and offline demonstration. Estimates are illustrative and do not reflect real-time pricing or live booking availability.
dataset_metadata.data_notice: All costs, attractions, and schedules are illustrative sample estimates for planning purposes only. Verify live availability and rates before travel.

destinations.name: Kyoto, Japan
destinations.overview: The cultural heart of Japan, home to thousands of classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, Shinto shrines, and traditional wooden machiya townhouses.

experiences.name: Fushimi Inari-taisha Torii Path
experiences.description: Ascend through thousands of vivid vermilion torii gates lining wooded mountain trails dedicated to the Shinto spirit of agriculture.
experiences.practical_tip: Begin your walk before 7:30 AM to experience peaceful atmosphere and uncrowded photo opportunities.

experiences.name: Nishiki Market Culinary Discovery
experiences.description: Known as 'Kyoto's Kitchen', this narrow five-block shopping street features over a hundred stalls serving skewers, matcha sweets, and seasonal seafood.
experiences.practical_tip: Eat purchases directly at designated vendor areas rather than walking while eating, following local etiquette.

experiences.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Tenryu-ji Garden
experiences.description: Wander through towering emerald bamboo stalks and visit the World Heritage Zen garden designed by master Muso Soseki.
experiences.practical_tip: Combine with a visit to the adjacent Iwatayama Monkey Park across the Togetsukyo Bridge.

experiences.name: Gion Historic Preservation District & Teahouses
experiences.description: Explore the cobblestone streets of Shirakawa and Hanami-koji, famous for traditional wooden machiya architecture and geiko culture.
experiences.practical_tip: Respect local signs prohibiting photography in private residential side alleys.

accommodations.name: Traditional Machiya Townhouse Guesthouse
accommodations.reason: Authentic tatami living experience within walking distance of central temples and riverside teahouses.
accommodations.note: Indicative estimate; rates increase during spring sakura and autumn foliage peak weeks.

accommodations.name: Kyoto Station Modern Boutique Hotel
accommodations.reason: Exceptional convenience for Shinkansen bullet trains, regional JR lines, and city bus terminals.
accommodations.note: Indicative estimate for standard single/double room.

accommodations.name: Luxury Riverside Ryokan Retreat
accommodations.reason: Fine kaiseki multi-course dinners and private hinoki cedar soaking tubs in secluded natural surroundings.
accommodations.note: Advance booking 2-3 months prior required.

logistics.overview: Kyoto has an intuitive municipal grid covered by extensive city buses, two subway lines, and multiple regional private railways.

transport_options.description: Covers virtually every tourist attraction with flat-fare central bus routes and fast subway arteries.
transport_options.notes: Tap rechargeable IC cards (ICOCA, Suica, Pasmo) at readers when boarding and exiting.

transport_options.description: Kyoto's flat terrain and bike lanes make cycling along the Kamogawa River enjoyable and efficient.
transport_options.notes: Park only in designated bicycle parking lots to avoid impoundment.

transport_options.description: Readily hailed at train stations and major crossings; helpful when traveling with luggage.
transport_options.notes: Rear doors open automatically; tipping is not customary.

tips: Purchase or top up an ICOCA IC transit card upon arrival at Kyoto Station.
Take subways or JR trains during peak morning hours to bypass surface bus traffic.
safety: Station platforms have safety announcements in Japanese and English.
Keep pedestrian sidewalks clear for cyclists.
verify: Check departure times for last return buses from outer mountain temples like Kurama or Takao.
Confirm coin locker luggage availability at major stations during festival periods.

travel_tips: Carry cash (Japanese Yen) as smaller shrines, neighborhood noodle shops, and market vendors may not take cards.
Remove outdoor footwear before stepping onto tatami mat flooring in temples and traditional restaurants.
Pack comfortable slip-on walking shoes suitable for frequent temple visits.

destinations.name: Rome, Italy
destinations.overview: The Eternal City, where nearly three millennia of globally influential art, architecture, and classical culture are on display at every cobblestone piazza.

experiences.name: Colosseum & Roman Forum Archaeological Walk
experiences.description: Step inside the grand amphitheater of the Roman Empire and walk the triumphal roads of the ancient Forum.
experiences.practical_tip: Book official timed-entry tickets online weeks in advance to avoid unauthorized street resellers.

experiences.name: Trastevere Evening Food & Wine Tasting
experiences.description: Stroll picturesque medieval alleyways sampling authentic Cacio e Pepe, crispy Roman suppli, and local Frascati wine.
experiences.practical_tip: Arrive around 8:00 PM when neighborhood trattorias open for traditional Roman dinner.

experiences.name: Pantheon & Piazza Navona Fountains
experiences.description: Marvel at the world's largest unreinforced concrete dome and Bernini's spectacular Fountain of the Four Rivers.
experiences.practical_tip: Pick up artisanal pistachio gelato at nearby Giolitti on your stroll.

experiences.name: Villa Borghese Gardens & Panoramic Pincio Terrace
experiences.description: A tranquil green oasis above the city offering sweeping views over Piazza del Popolo and the dome of St. Peter's.
experiences.practical_tip: Rent an electric surrey bike to tour the park grounds and landscaped ponds.

accommodations.name: Historic Center Boutique Hotel
accommodations.reason: Superb central location enabling you to walk to all iconic sights without taking transit.
accommodations.note: City tourist tax of approx. 6 EUR per person/night payable at check-in.

accommodations.name: Monti Neighborhood Guesthouse
accommodations.reason: Trendy, artisan neighborhood with cozy wine bars, just steps from the Colosseum.
accommodations.note: Indicative seasonal rate; walk-up staircases common in historic buildings.

accommodations.name: Luxury Hotel near Spanish Steps
accommodations.reason: Five-star service with private courtyard gardens and rooftop views of Roman terracotta rooftops.
accommodations.note: Includes concierge tour booking services.

logistics.overview: Rome is best explored on foot, supported by Metro Lines A & B, an extensive bus network, and trams.

transport_options.description: Two primary lines (A and B) intersecting at Roma Termini central station.
transport_options.notes: Standard BIT ticket is valid for 100 minutes from initial validation stamping.

transport_options.description: Frequent routes traversing historic piazzas and connecting outer neighborhoods.
transport_options.notes: Purchase tickets before boarding at newsstands (Tabacchi) or tap contactless payment cards.

transport_options.description: White city taxis operating from marked taxi ranks at major squares.
transport_options.notes: Ensure the meter starts on tariff 1 for urban rides.

tips: Validate paper transit tickets immediately upon boarding buses or entering metro turnstiles.
Carry a refillable water bottle to fill at Rome's historic public fountains (Nasoni).
safety: Stay alert to personal belongings on crowded Metro Line A trains and near Termini station.
Decline unsolicited offers from bracelet vendors or unofficial guides outside monument gates.
verify: Verify Vatican Museums operating hours (closed on most Sundays).
Confirm dress code compliance (covered shoulders and knees) for all church and basilica visits.

travel_tips: Dress respectfully for sacred sites: shoulders and knees must be covered to enter St. Peter's and churches.
Stand at the counter (al banco) for quick espresso in the morning like a local to save counter surcharges.
Cobblestone streets (sampietrini) require supportive, flat walking shoes.

destinations.name: Banff & Lake Louise, Canada
destinations.overview: Canada's oldest national park, nestled in the Rocky Mountains with glacier-fed turquoise lakes, dramatic peaks, and alpine wildlife.

experiences.name: Lake Louise & Agnes Tea House Hike
experiences.description: Hike through alpine fir forests from the shores of Lake Louise up to a historic mountain teahouse nestled next to Lake Agnes.
experiences.practical_tip: Carry cash (Canadian or US dollars) as the off-grid teahouse does not consistently process credit cards.

experiences.name: Moraine Lake & Valley of the Ten Peaks
experiences.description: Witness the luminous blue water of Moraine Lake framed by towering quartzite peaks in the Valley of the Ten Peaks.
experiences.practical_tip: Personal vehicles are restricted on Moraine Lake Road; reserve Parks Canada shuttle shuttles in advance.

experiences.name: Banff Upper Hot Springs Soak
experiences.description: Relax in mineral-rich natural thermal waters looking out over Mount Rundle and the surrounding Bow Valley.
experiences.practical_tip: Late afternoon visits offer soothing mountain sunset views.

experiences.name: Banff Gondola & Sulphur Mountain Boardwalk
experiences.description: Ride high above the pine canopy to the summit ridge for an expansive 360-degree vista of six Canadian mountain ranges.
experiences.practical_tip: Book morning time slots for clearer visibility before midday alpine cloud buildup.

accommodations.name: Banff Avenue Mountain Lodge
accommodations.reason: Centrally located on Banff Avenue with complimentary Roam transit passes included.
accommodations.note: National park entry pass is required per person/vehicle in addition to lodging.

accommodations.name: Alpine Forest Cabin Chalet
accommodations.reason: Quiet wooded setting with wood-burning fireplaces and mountain trails right outside.
accommodations.note: Includes full kitchenette facilities.

accommodations.name: Fairmont Chateau Lake Louise
accommodations.reason: Iconic world-renowned resort positioned right along the emerald shoreline.
accommodations.note: Early booking 6 months ahead recommended for peak summer and winter ski seasons.

logistics.overview: The park operates the clean, hybrid-electric Roam Transit network connecting Banff, Canmore, and Lake Louise.

transport_options.description: Convenient scheduled bus routes connecting Banff townsite, gondola, and Lake Louise.
transport_options.notes: Exact change or mobile app ticketing available.

transport_options.description: Dedicated shuttle service to Moraine Lake and Lake Louise lakeshores from park-and-ride.
transport_options.notes: Advance reservation via reservation.pc.gc.ca strongly recommended.

transport_options.description: Provides maximum flexibility for exploring the Icefields Parkway toward Jasper.
transport_options.notes: Requires valid Parks Canada National Park Pass displayed on windshield.

tips: Buy a Parks Canada Discovery Pass if staying more than 6 days in national parks.
Layer clothing with moisture-wicking synthetics and a waterproof outer shell.
safety: Carry bear spray on all hikes, know how to use it, and keep it easily accessible (not inside your backpack).
Stay at least 30 meters away from elk and 100 meters away from bears and cougars.
verify: Verify seasonal trail closures and bear activity notices at the Banff Visitor Centre.
Check road conditions along the Icefields Parkway before driving in shoulder seasons.

travel_tips: Pack warm layers, thermal gloves, and sunglasses regardless of season—alpine weather shifts rapidly.
Stay hydrated at high elevations (over 1,400 meters altitude in Banff townsite).
Keep wildlife wild: never feed animals, which is illegal and harmful to park ecosystems.

destinations.name: Bali (Ubud & Beaches), Indonesia
destinations.overview: The Island of the Gods, renowned for terraced rice paddies, ancient Hindu temples, surf breaks, wellness culture, and tropical warmth.

experiences.name: Tegallalang Rice Terraces & Subak Walk
experiences.description: Trek through lush terraced emerald rice fields utilizing the UNESCO-recognized 9th-century Subak irrigation system.
experiences.practical_tip: Wear footwear with solid grip as muddy pathways between tiers can become slick.

experiences.name: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary in Ubud
experiences.description: Walk among centuries-old banyan trees and moss-covered temples inhabited by over a thousand playful Balinese long-tailed macaques.
experiences.practical_tip: Secure all sunglasses, hats, jewelry, and loose bottles before entering the sanctuary.

experiences.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Volcanic Trek
experiences.description: Hike to the crater rim of active Mount Batur before dawn to watch the sunrise above the clouds and Lake Batur.
experiences.practical_tip: Dress in warm layers for the early morning pre-dawn chill before the sun rises.
experiences.estimated_cost: Approx. $30 - $45 USD with local mountain guide

experiences.name: Traditional Balinese Cooking & Spice Class
experiences.description: Visit an organic village market to select fresh galangal, lemongrass, and chilies before preparing a traditional multi-dish feast.
experiences.practical_tip: Most classes include round-trip transport from Ubud accommodations.

accommodations.name: Jungle Villa & Infinity Pool
accommodations.reason: Serene open-air villa surrounded by tropical greenery with daily made-to-order breakfast.
accommodations.note: Includes complimentary shuttle service into Ubud town center.

accommodations.name: Traditional Balinese Family Compound Guesthouse
accommodations.reason: Authentic courtyard experience with carved stone shrines, clean rooms, and friendly hospitality.
accommodations.note: Air conditioning and Wi-Fi included.

accommodations.name: Luxury Eco-Resort & Spa
accommodations.reason: World-class wellness sanctuaries with river valley vistas, daily yoga, and fine dining.
accommodations.note: Advance spa bookings recommended.

logistics.overview: Public transit is limited; travelers get around via private driver hires, metered Bluebird taxis, or rideshare apps (Grab/Gojek).

transport_options.description: Full-day dedicated car and driver for comfortable touring between sights and beaches.
transport_options.notes: Cost covers fuel, vehicle, and driver for up to 10 hours.

transport_options.description: Mobile rideshare apps for point-to-point car rides and short scooter hops.
transport_options.notes: Some central traditional villages have local transport pickup restrictions.

transport_options.description: Reliable metered taxis recognizable by their light blue color and logo.
transport_options.notes: Confirm the driver uses the meter (argo).

tips: Install the Grab or Gojek mobile app and connect a payment card for seamless transport.
Always wear a sarong and sash when entering Balinese temple compounds (often rentable at entrance).
safety: Drink bottled or filtered water exclusively; avoid tap water.
Only rent scooters if you possess an International Driving Permit and prior riding experience.
verify: Verify visa-on-arrival (VOA) requirements and tourist levy payment prior to airport immigration.
Confirm local village transport zone policies for app-based pickups.

travel_tips: Carry small Indonesian Rupiah cash for local warungs (family eateries) and temple donation boxes.
Respect daily offerings (canang sari) placed on pathways and stairs by stepping around them.
Apply reef-safe sunscreen and stay hydrated in the humid tropical climate.

destinations.name: Paris, France
destinations.overview: The City of Light, globally renowned for world-class museums, grand haussmannian boulevards, celebrated bistros, and iconic architectural vistas.

experiences.name: Musée du Louvre & Tuileries Gardens
experiences.description: Explore masterpieces spanning millennia, from the Mona Lisa and Winged Victory of Samothrace to French Romanticism.
experiences.practical_tip: Enter via the Carrousel du Louvre underground mall to bypass long outdoor pyramid queues.

experiences.name: Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur Artist Quarter
experiences.description: Wander winding cobblestone streets, Place du Tertre portrait painters, and the steps leading to the white basilica overlooking Paris.
experiences.practical_tip: Climb the dome of Sacré-Cœur for the highest open-air panoramic vantage point in the city.

experiences.name: Seine River Evening Promenade & Bistro Dining
experiences.description: Savor classic steak frites or duck confit at a neighborhood bistro before watching the Eiffel Tower sparkle on the hour.
experiences.practical_tip: Bistros typically serve dinner starting at 7:30 PM; reservations recommended on weekends.

experiences.name: Le Marais Historic Mansions & Boutiques
experiences.description: Discover 17th-century aristocratic hotels particuliers, indie fashion boutiques, and the historic Place des Vosges.
experiences.practical_tip: Sunday is a prime day to explore Le Marais when pedestrianized streets remain lively.

accommodations.name: Charming Left Bank Boutique Hotel
accommodations.reason: Classic Parisian balconies within walking distance of the Seine, cafes, and historic bookshops.
accommodations.note: Standard Parisian rooms are charming but compact in scale.

accommodations.name: Canal Saint-Martin Guesthouse
accommodations.reason: Trendy, youthful neighborhood brimming with bakeries, footbridges, and wine bars.
accommodations.note: Near Gare de l'Est and République transit hubs.

accommodations.name: Palace Hotel near Champs-Élysées
accommodations.reason: Unrivaled luxury, Michelin-starred gastronomy, and private terrace views of the Eiffel Tower.
accommodations.note: Includes white-glove concierge and spa access.

logistics.overview: Paris has one of the world's densest and most comprehensive public transit networks with 16 metro lines, 5 RER suburban trains, and buses.

transport_options.description: Rapid urban rail with stations rarely more than 400 meters apart in central Paris.
transport_options.notes: Use a contactless Navigo Easy card or purchase digital t+ tickets on smartphone.

transport_options.description: Citywide bicycle sharing system with mechanical and electric bikes across thousands of stations.
transport_options.notes: Great for cycling along the dedicated protected lanes of Rue de Rivoli.

transport_options.description: Regulated city taxis with fixed airport tariffs to Charles de Gaulle and Orly.
transport_options.notes: Fixed airport fare rules apply between Paris and CDG/Orly.

tips: Download the Île-de-France Mobilités or Citymapper mobile app for real-time transit routing.
Say 'Bonjour' politely when entering any shop, bakery, or cafe before speaking.
safety: Be watchful of your phone and wallet on Metro Line 1 and Line 4 during rush hour.
Ignore petition clipboards and shell game games on sidewalks near monuments.
verify: Confirm mandatory museum advance timed reservations (e.g. Louvre and Musée d'Orsay).
Check scheduled weekend engineering work on RER B if commuting to Charles de Gaulle airport.

travel_tips: A courteous 'Bonjour, Madame/Monsieur' is fundamental French social etiquette before making requests.
Tap water in cafes and bistros ('une carafe d'eau') is free, clean, and delicious by law.
Many museums are free on the first Sunday of each month, but require advance online booking.

destinations.name: Seoul, South Korea
destinations.overview: A dynamic 24-hour metropolis where ancient royal palaces and tranquil hanok villages coexist alongside gleaming futuristic skyscrapers, high-tech hubs, and K-culture trends.

experiences.name: Gyeongbokgung Royal Palace & Changing of Guard
experiences.description: Witness the colorful royal guard changing ceremony and explore the grand throne halls and lotus ponds of the Joseon Dynasty.
experiences.practical_tip: Visitors wearing traditional Korean Hanbok receive complimentary free admission to the palace.

experiences.name: Gwangjang Traditional Night Market
experiences.description: Savor sizzling bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), mayak kimbap, and kalguksu handmade noodle soup surrounded by steam and local market buzz.
experiences.practical_tip: Benches are equipped with heated seats during colder autumn and winter months.

experiences.name: Bukchon Hanok Village & Samcheong-dong
experiences.description: Stroll picturesque hill streets lined with hundreds of preserved 600-year-old traditional Korean wooden houses.
experiences.practical_tip: Bukchon is an active residential neighborhood; maintain quiet hours between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM.

experiences.name: DDP (Dongdaemun Design Plaza) & Tech District
experiences.description: Marvel at Zaha Hadid's neo-futuristic curved architecture, design labs, night shopping complexes, and technology showcases.
experiences.practical_tip: Visit after twilight when the exterior LED illumination transforms the structure.

accommodations.name: Myeongdong Modern City Hotel
accommodations.reason: Direct access to street food alleys, cosmetic shopping boulevards, and Line 4 subway station.
accommodations.note: English and Japanese speaking concierge desk available.

accommodations.name: Hongdae Youth & Indie Culture Stay
accommodations.reason: Vibrant arts district near university campuses filled with live street buskers and late-night cafes.
accommodations.note: Direct express train connection to Incheon International Airport.

accommodations.name: Luxury Hotel in Gangnam
accommodations.reason: Ultra-modern luxury suites near COEX mall, K-star road, and Michelin-starred contemporary Korean dining.
accommodations.note: Includes access to indoor Olympic-size lap pool and executive lounge.

logistics.overview: Seoul features arguably the world's most punctual and technologically advanced subway and bus network, with 4G/5G and heated seats throughout.

transport_options.description: Comprehensive subway network with English station announcements, digital maps, and glass platform safety doors.
transport_options.notes: Tap T-money card when entering and exiting to calculate distance fares.

transport_options.description: Blue (arterial), green (branch), and red (express) buses reaching every corner of the city.
transport_options.notes: Free transit transfer discount applies when switching between bus and subway within 30 minutes.

transport_options.description: Inexpensive, clean metered city taxis easily hailed curbside or summoned through the Kakao T app.
transport_options.notes: Drivers accept credit cards and T-money transit cards directly.

tips: Purchase a reloadable T-money card at any convenience store (CU, GS25, 7-Eleven) upon arrival.
Download Naver Map or KakaoMap on your phone as Google Maps has limited walking directions in South Korea due to local mapping regulations.
safety: Seoul is one of the safest global cities with extremely low crime rates.
Pedestrian crosswalks have countdown timers and ground-level LED light bars.
verify: Verify museum and palace weekly closure days (most royal palaces close on either Mondays or Tuesdays).
Confirm airport express train (AREX) schedule when planning early morning departures from Incheon.

travel_tips: Install Naver Map or KakaoMap prior to arrival for accurate pedestrian walking directions.
Use both hands when giving or receiving money, cards, or drinks as a respectful cultural gesture.
Tipping is not practiced or expected anywhere in South Korea.

destinations.name: Arenal & La Fortuna, Costa Rica
destinations.overview: The eco-adventure capital of Central America, boasting conical volcanoes, rainforest canopy suspension bridges, tumbling waterfalls, and geothermal hot springs.

experiences.name: Mistico Arenal Hanging Bridges Rainforest Canopy Walk
experiences.description: Walk along suspension bridges strung across the rainforest canopy to view toucans, howler monkeys, and sloths.
experiences.practical_tip: Hire a certified naturalist guide with a spotting scope at the entrance for tenfold more wildlife sightings.

experiences.name: La Fortuna Waterfall & River Canyon Swim
experiences.description: Descend 500 forested steps into a volcanic canyon to marvel at the 70-meter cascade pouring into an emerald pool.
experiences.practical_tip: Wear water shoes to navigate the smooth river boulders safely.

experiences.name: Natural Geothermal Hot Springs Relaxation
experiences.description: Soak in volcanic thermal river pools surrounded by lush orchids, palms, and cascading warm water currents.
experiences.practical_tip: Many hot springs resorts offer combined day-pass packages that include a traditional Costa Rican lunch or dinner.

experiences.name: Organic Coffee & Chocolate Plantation Tour
experiences.description: Learn the traditional bean-to-bar chocolate making and coffee roasting processes from local agriculturalists.
experiences.practical_tip: Fresh roasted single-origin volcanic coffee beans make fantastic take-home gifts.

accommodations.name: Eco-Lodge with Arenal Volcano View
accommodations.reason: Direct uninterrupted views of the volcano cone, on-site trails, and toucans visiting morning fruit feeders.
accommodations.note: Includes traditional Gallo Pinto breakfast.

accommodations.name: Downtown La Fortuna Guesthouse
accommodations.reason: Walking distance to local sodas (traditional diners), tour operators, and public parks.
accommodations.note: Clean, air-conditioned rooms with communal kitchen access.

accommodations.name: Luxury Rainforest Thermal Springs Resort
accommodations.reason: Private thermal mineral spring pools directly on resort grounds nestled deep in primary rainforest.
accommodations.note: Advance booking recommended for dry season (December-April).

logistics.overview: Taxis, tourist shared shuttles, and rental cars are the primary modes of travel between San José, Arenal, and local nature reserves.

transport_options.description: Air-conditioned vans (Interbus / RideCR) running hotel-to-hotel between San José airport and La Fortuna.
transport_options.notes: Advance booking recommended; journey takes approx. 3.5 hours.

transport_options.description: Licensed red 4x4 taxis operating with meters or standard flat tariffs in the La Fortuna area.
transport_options.notes: Readily available at the central church park in La Fortuna.

transport_options.description: Ideal for independent exploration of unpaved lake access roads and hidden thermal rivers.
transport_options.notes: High-clearance SUV recommended for rural country roads.

tips: US Dollars are widely accepted alongside Costa Rican Colones across hotels, tours, and restaurants.
Carry a lightweight rain jacket or poncho even in dry season as sudden tropical showers occur.
safety: Always swim in designated calm areas below waterfalls and heed safety flags.
Keep car doors locked and do not leave luggage unattended in parked vehicles at trailhead turnouts.
verify: Verify operating hours and advance booking requirements for national park access.
Confirm weather forecasts if planning morning canopy ziplining or suspension bridge tours.

travel_tips: 'Pura Vida' (pure life) is the national greeting and philosophy—embrace a relaxed, unhurried pace.
Dine at local 'Sodas' for authentic, generous, and inexpensive Casado plates (rice, beans, plantains, and protein).
Biodegradable insect repellent and reef-safe sunscreen are essential for rainforest exploration.
